Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, including drivers under twenty-one and future commercial drivers who face lower alcohol limits.
Why it matters to a first-timer: accepting a license means consenting to alcohol and drug tests, and a test at or over the limit ends the privilege on the spot [A01], DUI penalties climb steeply with alcohol level and repeat offenses [A02], and an interlock device controls whether a convicted driver's car will start [A03].
Level: practical recall of several alcohol thresholds, penalty minimums and repeat-offense steps that are easy to mix up.
Prerequisites: the license points, suspension and revocation pages that precede this section.
